heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Construct
tree.text: The term “construct” means to construct, acquire, install, improve, or extend a facility or system.

tree.heading: Cost of money loan
tree.text: The term “cost of money loan” means a loan made under this chapter bearing interest at a rate equal to the then current cost to the Federal Government of loans of similar maturity.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

tree.heading: Rural area
tree.text: The term “rural area” has the meaning given the term in section 950bb(b)(3) of this title.

notes.heading: Termination of Section
notes.text: For termination of section by section 1(b) of Pub. L. 102–551, see Termination of Chapter note set out under section 950aaa of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 950aaa–1, Pub. L. 101–624, title XXIII, § 2332, Nov. 28, 1990, 104 Stat. 4017; Pub. L. 102–237, title VII, § 702(g), Dec. 13, 1991, 105 Stat. 1880, provided goal of Federal Government to make affordable advanced telecommunications available to rural residents, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by Pub. L. 104–127.
